propositions: A class may name a model that becomes unreachable due to local endpoint downtime or provider throttling, causing the gate to fail with no fallback mechanism available

Per-class fallback chains must be constructed from inline model configs using pydantic-ai's FallbackModel wrapper, with fallback_on set to a predicate covering availability and rate-limit errors but excluding credential and input-size failures
Fallback entries carrying custom endpoints must be honored during model construction, and all fallback clients must share a single ProviderSession lifecycle with exact once-closure semantics

Capabilities must be computed as the conservative intersection across all chain candidates before the FallbackModel wrapper exists, and provider_provenance must record both the ordered candidates and the actual ran_model from the response
The fallback_on predicate must be derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL to ensure taxonomy changes propagate without manual drift
A 429 error split exists: plain rate-limit 429 (WAIT_AND_RETRY) falls back, but 429 with insufficient_quota (INCREASE_PROVIDER_LIMITS) does not, to prevent masking spend exhaustion
